text:
Maria Chen: heads-up — want to propose a small dashboard + backfill we can use to correlate per-route token-level latency regressions with GPU slice/MIG behavior and kernel selector decisions. thinking: one pane with per-route p50/p95 token-latency, another with sm occupancy heatmap by MIG slice, and a third showing recent kernel-choice churn.

Kevin Patel: +1. do we have the metrics instrumentation for per-token breakdown per route? last time we had to stitch traces and it was messy.

AJ (runtime): we do emit token_latency_ms (bucketed by token_position) and route_id as labels, but only sampled in traces. we added a streaming token histogram in the agent a month ago that can be exported. need to enable for a week to backfill.

Olga S.: can we avoid full trace export? sampling at 5% + the new histograms should be enough. also want a kv_cache hit rate overlay — I suspect tail latencies line up with low kv hit rate and kernel fallbacks.

Maria Chen: agree. plan: enable the streaming histogram for routes with >100 qps for 7 days, run backfill queries, then build dashboards. I sketched queries:
```promql
# per-route p95 token latency (ms)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route_id))
```
and:
```promql
# average sm_occupancy per mig_slice over 5m
avg_over_time(gpu_sm_occupancy{slice!~""}[5m]) by (gpu, mig_slice)
```

Kevin Patel: those look fine. for kernel churn, what label do we have? kernel_name on the request span?

AJ (runtime): yes, kernel_selector.decided_kernel is attached to the final exec span. we emit kernel_fallback_count and kernel_choice tag per-request. sample query: 
```promql
sum(increase(kernel_fallback_count[1h])) by (kernel_name)
```

Olga S.: recommend a combined panel that shows route p95 and overlay: kv_cache_hit_rate, kernel_fallback_rate, and sm_occupancy percentiles. colors: red if p95 > 120ms and fallback_rate > 0.5%.

metrics-bot: alert rule created (draft): /alerts/eng-runtime/slo-backfill-high-p95 — triggers if route_p95_tokens > 120ms for 5m AND kernel_fallback_rate > 0.005 for same window.

Maria Chen: nice. infra-bot — can you spin a 7d retention query job to collect the histograms into the metrics cluster? we want this separated from regular ingest to avoid cardinality blowup.

infra-bot: creating job: metrics-backfill/1717352468 — writes to temporary metrics namespace 'backfill_eng_runtime_1717352468'. ETA ~ 2h. includes label scrubber for low-cardinality route_id mapping.

Kevin Patel: for GPU metrics, let's include VRAM_usage_percent and a thermal violation overlay (gpu_temp_c > 85 flagged). MIG slice imbalance metric would be slice_util_stddev across slices.

AJ (runtime): adding example query for MIG imbalance: 
```promql
stddev_over_time(avg_over_time(gpu_sm_occupancy{mig_slice!~""}[1m]) by (gpu, mig_slice)[10m:1m])
```
This gives a rolling stddev across slices per GPU.

Olga S.: once backfill complete, i'll assemble a dashboard draft and post screenshot in #eng-runtime. aim to have a canary dashboard (read-only) before we expose to product teams.

Maria Chen: timeline?

Kevin Patel: 2 days to enable and run backfill, 1 day to build dashboard, 1 day for review = EOW if infra job kicks off today.

AJ (runtime): i'll instrument a small counter for 'kernel_selector.retries' and add a tag for quantization_profile so we can correlate quantized-run fallbacks.

Maria Chen: perfect. thanks all. follow-ups: @Olga S. will post the dashboard draft, @AJ (runtime) will open a PR to emit retries counter, infra-bot will post when backfill job completes and provide backfill namespace.

metrics-bot: backfill job completed (2h16m). samples stored in backfill_eng_runtime_1717352468.

Olga S.: posted dashboard draft: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/d/xyz123/slo-backfill-draft — feedback welcome. screenshot attached. :eyes:

Kevin Patel: looks good — can we add a small table listing top 5 routes by p95 regression and the dominant kernel fallback for each?

Maria Chen: yes, add that to the bottom. we'll iterate after first-day data. :thumbsup:
